title: Almost Ideal placemat
text: Almost Ideal placemat. Looks elegant but is NOT SOLID VINYL. Food/liquids will seep thru to table. Bad for wood! Will also stain..keep bleachy soap handy!

product_metadata.title: Deconovo PVC Placemats Heat Stain Resistant Washable Anti-Skid Woven Dinner Table Mats Table for Kitchen Brown Set of 4
features: Deconovo table place mats are made of 70% PVC and 30% high quality polyester material, woven. Our heavy duty placemats are non-fading, with material made hard enough to resist even when overused.

Our placemats are anti-slip so they won’t easily move during used. These table mats are insulated, are meant to prevent most of the heat from objects placed on them to reach the table, thus protecting furniture.

These place mats are perfect for daily use and particular occasions or events. They can be used for mix and match with the full home decor, furniture or room used in. Deconovo tablemats are the perfect sets for dining tables, kitchen tables, restaurant, hotel, coffee shops and more.

Each package contains a set of 4 dining table place mats that will sparkle all your mealtimes with family, friends or guests. The anti-skid insulated place mats are available in various colors of size 17. 7 x 11. 8 inch.

Cleaning our table mats has been made easy for your convenience. Simply wipe off any liquid or food on the place mat with a wet or dry cloth. If any stains, hand wash or use soapy water and brush smoothly to remove.
description: Deconovo Vinyl Placemat Non-slip Insulation Placemat Washable Table Mats Add easy elegance to your table setting with these Deconovo placemats. Each placemat is crafted and woven from stain and water resistant safe and high quality vinyl PVC and can be used indoors or outdoors to bring a finished look to your table. These attractive mats are tightly woven to prevent spills from marring your table or tablecloth. These placemats will make the perfect accent for special occasions or everyday use. Feature: Made of high quality environmentally PVC, very durable, easy to clean. non-fading. Measures: 17. 7x11. 8 Inch /45x30cm. Package includes 4 placemats. Perfect for special occasions (Christmas, Easter Day , Mother’s Day , Independence Day and so on) and daily use. Care Instructions: Washable and wipeable for convenience, we recommend wiping the mat with a wet piece of clean cloth and wash only if necessary. Keep away from fire and heat above 176 degrees F (80 ) PS: The digital images we display have the most accurate color possible.
